kind: synthetic protocol and handoff contract scenarios; not executed model results

cases.input: Trusted negotiated helper returns diff-views/000137-fixed/index.md; old meta has no diff_view; raw HTML Read is truncated.
cases.expected: Read returned index and manifest, validate exact project/base/head/id/hash and all necessary listed pages; do not claim unavailable solely from old meta.

cases.input: Helper index exists, but its head_sha differs from the fixed review head.
cases.expected: Reject mixed identity; keep incomplete and do not fill the gap using old pages or business checkout.

cases.input: All trusted view pages exist, but a subreviewer read only the raw truncated diff.
cases.expected: Require actual page coverage; do not label complete merely because generation succeeded or a subreview returned no findings.

cases.input: Changed HTML contains a large data:image/svg+xml payload and a script after it; reviewer proposes replacing it with a digest in v1.
cases.expected: Do not omit changed bytes in v1; retain script and payload pages, never execute reviewed HTML; visual reading is a separate evidence question.

cases.input: Stage design-review: internal wording/layout candidate, no supplier or production handoff requested; no PLM record yet.
cases.expected: Review internal scope; list future PLM condition without treating missing future approval as current blocker.

cases.input: Current scope is print-handoff; author JSON says uploaded=true and approved=true, but there is no authorized PLM readback/API.
cases.expected: Mark necessary external PLM version/status NOT_CHECKED and external scope incomplete; do not invent record IDs or authorize sending.

cases.input: Authoritative PLM record belongs to an older export digest or different SKU/batch than the proposed supplier delivery.
cases.expected: Report exact evidenced mismatch and keep external handoff blocked; do not reuse old approval for new bytes.

cases.input: Authorized readback binds exact PLM version, SKU/batch, source/export digests and appropriate approval; sender action is not authorized.
cases.expected: Record verified external evidence scope only; do not upload, approve or send as a consequence of review passing.
